title: Canonical identification of the transported comparison
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, composable scheme morphisms $Z\xrightarrow{h}X\xrightarrow{f}Y$ with $\ell$ invertible at every point, three constructible derived-complete integral objects $M_i$ on $Y$, arbitrary flat-term K-flat representatives $P_i$, and isomorphisms $Q(P_i)\cong M_i$. Use the exact quotient complexes, finite expressions, substitutions and transports of [def-pur-completed-comparison-quotient-realization-data]. For any GoodExpressions and invertibility proofs, transport of the strict pullback-tensor comparison hom is the hom of canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor. StrictCoherence holds at both E and L, and NaturalComparison holds at both E and L under arbitrary derived morphisms. The canonical integral comparison used here is the coherent-counit construction of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-integral-construction]; scalar compatibility of that comparison is not assumed.

proof.text: For each $n$ apply [lem-pur-cochain-pullback-tensor-coherence] to the ringed-topos map $f_n$. It gives exactly the displayed formulas for $c_n$ and $c_n^{-1}$, natural in the complex arguments and commuting with all quotient transitions. Hence these maps define inverse strict tower maps $c:f^*T_\bullet\cong W_\bullet$. Apply the functor $\mathcal L_E$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]; functoriality sends $c^{-1}c=1$ and $cc^{-1}=1$ to the inverse equations. The substitution maps from step 1 therefore give inverse maps between $K_s$ and $K_t$.

proof.text: Put $A=f^*T_\bullet$, $B=W_\bullet$, and let $e$ be the coherent counit. The primitive comparisons of [lem-pur-completed-primitive-counit-comparison] are the comparisons for the actual completed operations and are natural in the derived system category, with the prescribed Roos/total-limit identification. Consequently the characterization in [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-integral-construction] identifies their conjugate $\beta_t^{-1}\mathcal L_E(c)\beta_s$ with the specified canonical comparison, and the conjugate of $\mathcal L_E(c^{-1})$ with its inverse. This proves equality with the fixed maps, rather than merely existence of an isomorphism. On flat-term K-flat representatives, naturality is the naturality of $c$ and these functor comparisons. By [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent], the localization of the flat-term K-flat homotopy category is the ambient derived category and transformations on its product extend uniquely. Thus naturality holds for all derived morphisms in $M,N$, and changing simultaneous representatives gives the same comparison through the canonical model identifications.

source.place: Integral level; identifying the specified comparison and descending representative naturality (agent assembly of the cited localization results).

proof.text: The reassociation, Koszul-signed symmetry, both action-unit and pullback-composition equations in [lem-pur-cochain-pullback-tensor-coherence] apply to $P_n,Q_n,J_n$ and to $f_n,h_n,(f\circ h)_n$. That statement also makes the maps compatible with every quotient transition. These are therefore commuting strict-system diagrams. Under [lem-pur-completed-operation-tower-substitution] their limit vertices and structural arrows are precisely the completed expressions, their specified associators, signed symmetries, unitors and composition maps. Applying the functor $\mathcal L_E$ preserves the equations. Its counit compatibility and the whole-system calculation of step 4 identify the reductions of the resulting diagrams with those strict-system diagrams.

lean.statement:
theorem completedComparisonCanonicalIdentification
    {Z X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (M : Fin 3 → sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y)
    (P : Fin 3 → (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
    (φ : ∀ i : Fin 3, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (P i).obj ≅ (M i).obj)
    (good : GoodExpressions l E h f P)
    (invertible : ∀ {W : Scheme.{u}} (A : StrictQuotient.Expression h f 3 W),
      IsIso (substitution l E P (fun i ↦ (M i).obj) φ good A)) :
    (transport l E P (fun i ↦ (M i).obj) φ good invertible
      (sourceExpression h f) (targetExpression h f)
      (comparison l E f (quotient l E (P 0).obj) (quotient l E (P 1).obj)).hom =
        (canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l E f (M 0) (M 1)).hom.hom) ∧
    StrictCoherence l E h f ∧ StrictCoherence l L h f ∧
    NaturalComparison l E f ∧ NaturalComparison l L f
